sqlpool-hero.alt: A finite bank of database connection lanes with an admission queue and one lane held by unfinished results.

sqlpool-detail.alt: Three operations enclosed in one transaction on a single connection, with an unrelated path kept outside.

sqlpool-infographic.alt: Budget, Bound, Release and Measure: four stages of connection-pool ownership and observation.

shutdown-hero.alt: Two service replicas accept requests while a third closes admission and drains work already inside.

shutdown-detail.alt: Preparation, draining and cleanup share one finite shutdown budget; overdue work reaches a stop boundary.

shutdown-infographic.alt: Stop routing, Drain, Join and Close, with one finite grace period beneath the complete sequence.

synctest-hero.alt: A virtual clock and synchronized goroutine tracks inside a test bubble, separate from real-world I/O.

synctest-detail.alt: Arbitrary hourglass delays contrasted with an explicit channel handshake and an observed result.

synctest-infographic.alt: Signal, Advance, Settle and Assert: channel events and virtual time establish when a test may check state.

gcpacer-hero.alt: Conceptual Go memory graph: live blocks connected to roots and unreachable blocks awaiting reclamation.

gcpacer-detail.alt: Separate conceptual controls for allocation headroom and a soft runtime memory budget, with external memory outside the runtime area.

gcpacer-infographic.alt: GC investigation workflow: measure the workload, bound memory demand, adjust one setting, verify the result.

heapgraph-hero.alt: A chain and a branching object graph illustrate logical depth; the measured lab uses equal node counts.

heapgraph-detail.alt: A small view keeps a large backing buffer reachable; an independent copy has separate storage.

heapgraph-infographic.alt: Reachability workflow showing roots, references, live objects and release after all root paths are removed.

alloclab-hero.alt: Three conceptual lenses distinguish allocation traffic, retained objects and execution time.

alloclab-detail.alt: Equivalent formatting results compared across a general formatter and a typed append workflow.

alloclab-infographic.alt: Performance investigation workflow: reproduce, profile, change one implementation, then recheck behavior and resources.

streamio-hero.alt: A final data chunk and an end marker arrive together; a gopher receives the bytes before ending the read.

streamio-detail.alt: Separate conceptual gates enforce an input byte budget and a complete document boundary.

streamio-infographic.alt: Read, bound, parse and check: distinguish returned bytes, finite budgets, document framing and explicit outcomes.

gotime-hero.alt: The same instant viewed through different local clocks, with a separate calendar representing civil dates.

gotime-detail.alt: A stopwatch and a calendar follow different tracks, illustrating elapsed duration versus a location-aware calendar day.

gotime-infographic.alt: Define, locate, calculate and test: choose a time contract, location rules, arithmetic and fixed transition cases.

invariants-hero.alt: Two separately protected updates converge into one output, illustrating a lost update between synchronized operations.

invariants-detail.alt: Readers retain a completed configuration while a writer assembles a separate version before atomic publication.

invariants-infographic.alt: Define, protect, publish and test: identify an invariant, protect its complete transition, publish owned state and test competing operations.

retrykey-hero.alt: A completed operation loses its reply; a repeated ticket matches a stored record and receives the original receipt.

retrykey-detail.alt: An effect and its receipt share one commit boundary while the reply channel and an independent external service remain outside it.

retrykey-infographic.alt: Identify, commit, replay and reconcile: preserve operation identity, record the effect and result, replay matching requests and investigate uncertain outcomes.

godirections-hero.alt: A gopher chooses among API services, command-line tools, cloud infrastructure and a smaller AI application path.

godirections-infographic.alt: Search, usage and engineering fit are separate kinds of evidence for evaluating Go.

godirections-detail.alt: An AI component is surrounded by bounded service queues, cancellation and explicit application boundaries.

slogfield-hero.alt: A gopher organizes diagnostic event cards into structured groups while a secret remains outside the event stream.

slogfield-infographic.alt: Select, structure, redact and test: design safe diagnostic event fields and verify the resulting schema.

slogfield-detail.alt: A completed application receipt and a blocked diagnostic sink follow separate paths with an explicit overflow choice.

gohiring-hero.alt: A gopher compares job requirements, survey evidence and a working project before navigating application review stages.

gohiring-infographic.alt: Define, compare, build and review: use clear cohorts, separate evidence sources and inspectable engineering work.

gohiring-detail.alt: Successful application receipts are displayed separately from pending candidates, illustrating selection bias.

ctxbudget-hero.alt: One finite time budget passes through a queue, HTTP service and database while cancellation reaches owned workers.

ctxbudget-infographic.alt: Locate, budget, cancel and verify: diagnose a waiting stage, preserve the time budget and test worker completion.

ctxbudget-detail.alt: A remote operation completes after the caller stops waiting, while a separate reconciliation path checks its recorded result.

unicodefield-hero.alt: A gopher examines storage bytes, individual code-point tokens and combined visual clusters through separate lenses.

unicodefield-infographic.alt: Bytes, runes, clusters and policy are different text-processing concepts; geometric tokens carry no measured encoding counts.

unicodefield-detail.alt: A retained small substring remains connected to a large allocation, while an independent copied prefix has separate storage.

unicodefield-normalization.alt: Canonical-equivalent representations meet at a normalization boundary, while a visually similar distinct token stays separate.

unicodefield-stream.alt: An incomplete encoded token crosses two input chunks and is held until completion; end of input exposes an unfinished token.
